audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Diana on all seven rows while the packet chart, the content win[] and a 53.31% Xerath win rate all say Xerath on all seven — and the full-layer whys themselves described Xerath winning.
audit.why: Pre-6 Diana has no gap-closer (Lunar Rush needs a landed Q mark, 22s base) and only a 900-range Q vs your 750/1000/1050 kit; post-6 the held E stun answers her R-dash. Data and both other sources agree.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides moved to Xerath with Diana-grounded whys; win[] already correct so no content edits.

audit.why: Spikes accurate: pre-6 zoning window, level 6 Moonfall threat answered by held E, 1st item Q-dodge denies the reset, late peel-and-poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: 22 lint findings: Diana misgendered as he/his across the full layer; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; cooldowns field with no digit; Pale Cascade shield missing interaction absent.
audit.why: Diana is she/her. Her W (15s rank 1) shields her through your burst — commit after it is out. Crescent Strike 8s; Lunar Rush 22s but free on a marked target; Moonfall 100s.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every non-report field plus two report entries; bullets rewritten to match titles; cooldowns given real numbers with the shield noted.

audit.why: Lunar Rush 22s unmarked and Moonfall 100s are the punish windows.
